// Normalizes Delinea Platform privileged-access audit events from the
// DelineaAuditEvents_CL table to the ASIM Audit Event schema (version 0.1.2).
//
// The audit-events API (X-Api-Version 2.0) returns the event descriptors as
// nested objects - eventType, service, actor, target and source - so the
// promoted EventType and Service columns hold the serialized objects rather
// than scalars. Every normalized value is therefore read from RawData, which
// the data collection rule fills with the complete event document.
//
// Event names are PascalCase compounds whose trailing word is the verb, for
// example 'PolicyDeploymentStateUpdated'. eventType.verb is used when the
// reporting service populates it; the event name is the fallback.
let EventTypeLookup = datatable(DelineaVerbKey: string, NormalizedEventType: string)
[
    'viewed',         'Read',
    'view',           'Read',
    'read',           'Read',
    'retrieved',      'Read',
    'accessed',       'Read',
    'exported',       'Read',
    'downloaded',     'Read',
    'checkedout',     'Read',
    'created',        'Create',
    'added',          'Create',
    'imported',       'Create',
    'generated',      'Create',
    'registered',     'Create',
    'deleted',        'Delete',
    'removed',        'Delete',
    'revoked',        'Delete',
    'updated',        'Set',
    'changed',        'Set',
    'modified',       'Set',
    'renamed',        'Set',
    'moved',          'Set',
    'assigned',       'Set',
    'unassigned',     'Set',
    'synchronized',   'Set',
    'checkedin',      'Set',
    'enabled',        'Enable',
    'activated',      'Enable',
    'unlocked',       'Enable',
    'disabled',       'Disable',
    'deactivated',    'Disable',
    'locked',         'Disable',
    'executed',       'Execute',
    'launched',       'Execute',
    'started',        'Execute',
    'ran',            'Execute',
    'installed',      'Install',
    'cleared',        'Clear',
    'purged',         'Clear',
];
// ASIM ObjectType is an enumerated list [ Configuration Atom, Policy Rule,
// Cloud Resource, Other ]. The platform reports target.type as an identifier
// name such as 'PolicyId' or 'SecretId', so the trailing 'Id' is trimmed
// before lookup and the original value is preserved in AdditionalFields.
let ObjectTypeLookup = datatable(DelineaTargetType: string, NormalizedObjectType: string)
[
    'SECRET',           'Cloud Resource',
    'FOLDER',           'Cloud Resource',
    'SERVER',           'Cloud Resource',
    'MACHINE',          'Cloud Resource',
    'ACCOUNT',          'Cloud Resource',
    'DATABASE',         'Cloud Resource',
    'RESOURCE',         'Cloud Resource',
    'SESSION',          'Cloud Resource',
    'ENGINE',           'Cloud Resource',
    'CONNECTOR',        'Cloud Resource',
    'USER',             'Configuration Atom',
    'IDENTITY',         'Configuration Atom',
    'GROUP',            'Configuration Atom',
    'ROLE',             'Configuration Atom',
    'APPLICATION',      'Configuration Atom',
    'CONFIGURATION',    'Configuration Atom',
    'COLLECTION',       'Configuration Atom',
    'ORGUNIT',          'Configuration Atom',
    'SERVICE',          'Configuration Atom',
    'TENANT',           'Configuration Atom',
    'POLICY',           'Policy Rule',
    'CREDENTIALPOLICY', 'Policy Rule',
    'PERMISSION',       'Policy Rule',
    'ENTITLEMENT',      'Policy Rule',
    'RULE',             'Policy Rule',
];
let parser = (disabled: bool = false)
{
    DelineaAuditEvents_CL
    | where not(disabled)
    | extend
        DelineaEvent = parse_json(RawData)
    | extend
        DelineaEventType = DelineaEvent.eventType,
        DelineaActor = DelineaEvent.actor,
        DelineaTarget = DelineaEvent.target,
        DelineaSourceHost = DelineaEvent.source.host,
        DelineaAttributes = DelineaEvent.additionalAttributes
    | extend
        DelineaEventName = tostring(coalesce(DelineaEventType.name, DelineaEventType.internalName)),
        DelineaTargetHost = DelineaTarget.host
    | extend
        DelineaEventNameKey = tolower(DelineaEventName),
        // eventType.verb is reported empty for most events, in which case the
        // verb is the trailing word of the PascalCase event name.
        DelineaVerb = iff(isnotempty(tostring(DelineaEventType.verb)),
                          tostring(DelineaEventType.verb),
                          extract(@'([A-Za-z][a-z]+)$', 1, DelineaEventName)),
        DelineaTargetTypeOriginal = tostring(coalesce(DelineaTarget.type, DelineaEventType.targetType)),
        // The attributes bag carries either scalars or single element arrays
        // depending on the reporting service.
        DelineaFailReason = tostring(coalesce(DelineaAttributes.FailReason[0], DelineaAttributes.FailReason)),
        DelineaMfaResult = tostring(coalesce(DelineaAttributes.MfaResult[0], DelineaAttributes.MfaResult)),
        DelineaFactorPassword = tostring(coalesce(DelineaAttributes.FactorPassword[0], DelineaAttributes.FactorPassword))
    | extend
        DelineaVerbKey = tolower(DelineaVerb),
        DelineaTargetType = trim_end(@'ID', toupper(DelineaTargetTypeOriginal)),
        // '0.0.0.0' is the placeholder reported for events that have no
        // network origin, such as system initiated events.
        DelineaSrcIpAddr = tostring(DelineaSourceHost.network.ipAddress),
        DelineaDstIpAddr = tostring(DelineaTargetHost.network.ipAddress)
    | lookup EventTypeLookup on DelineaVerbKey
    | lookup ObjectTypeLookup on DelineaTargetType
    | extend
        EventType = case(
            isnotempty(NormalizedEventType), NormalizedEventType,
            // Names that do not end in a verb are matched on their content.
            // The compound names are not term indexed, so 'contains' is used.
            DelineaEventNameKey contains 'delete' or DelineaEventNameKey contains 'remove' or DelineaEventNameKey contains 'revoke', 'Delete',
            DelineaEventNameKey contains 'update' or DelineaEventNameKey contains 'change' or DelineaEventNameKey contains 'modif' or DelineaEventNameKey contains 'rename' or DelineaEventNameKey contains 'assign' or DelineaEventNameKey contains 'checkedin' or DelineaEventNameKey contains 'checkin', 'Set',
            DelineaEventNameKey contains 'create' or DelineaEventNameKey contains 'import' or DelineaEventNameKey contains 'generate' or DelineaEventNameKey contains 'add', 'Create',
            DelineaEventNameKey contains 'enable' or DelineaEventNameKey contains 'activate' or DelineaEventNameKey contains 'unlock', 'Enable',
            DelineaEventNameKey contains 'disable' or DelineaEventNameKey contains 'deactivate' or DelineaEventNameKey contains 'lock', 'Disable',
            DelineaEventNameKey contains 'view' or DelineaEventNameKey contains 'read' or DelineaEventNameKey contains 'retriev' or DelineaEventNameKey contains 'export' or DelineaEventNameKey contains 'download' or DelineaEventNameKey contains 'checkedout' or DelineaEventNameKey contains 'checkout', 'Read',
            DelineaEventNameKey contains 'execut' or DelineaEventNameKey contains 'launch' or DelineaEventNameKey contains 'invoke' or DelineaEventNameKey contains 'run', 'Execute',
            DelineaEventNameKey contains 'install', 'Install',
            DelineaEventNameKey contains 'clear' or DelineaEventNameKey contains 'purge', 'Clear',
            'Other'),
        ObjectType = iff(isempty(NormalizedObjectType), 'Other', NormalizedObjectType),
        EventCount = int(1),
        EventVendor = 'Delinea',
        EventProduct = 'Delinea Platform',
        EventSchema = 'AuditEvent',
        EventSchemaVersion = '0.1.2',
        // eventDateTime is when the platform recorded the event, ahead of the
        // processedTime at which it became available to the connector.
        EventStartTime = coalesce(todatetime(DelineaEvent.eventDateTime), TimeGenerated),
        EventEndTime = coalesce(todatetime(DelineaEvent.eventDateTime), TimeGenerated),
        EventUid = _ItemId,
        EventOriginalUid = tostring(DelineaEvent.eventMessageId),
        EventOriginalType = DelineaEventName,
        EventMessage = tostring(coalesce(DelineaEvent.displayMessage, DelineaEvent.notes)),
        Operation = DelineaEventName,
        EventResult = case(
            DelineaMfaResult =~ 'Failed' or DelineaFactorPassword =~ 'Failed' or isnotempty(DelineaFailReason), 'Failure',
            DelineaVerbKey in ('failed', 'denied', 'rejected', 'blocked'), 'Failure',
            DelineaEventNameKey contains 'fail' or DelineaEventNameKey contains 'denied' or DelineaEventNameKey contains 'reject' or DelineaEventNameKey contains 'blocked' or DelineaEventNameKey contains 'unauthorized', 'Failure',
            'Success'),
        ActorUsername = tostring(coalesce(DelineaActor.email, DelineaActor.name, DelineaActor.displayName)),
        ActorUserId = tostring(DelineaActor.id),
        ActorUserIdType = 'Other',
        ActorOriginalUserType = tostring(DelineaActor.type),
        ActorUserType = case(
            tostring(DelineaActor.type) =~ 'system' or tostring(DelineaEvent.isSystem) =~ 'true', 'System',
            tostring(DelineaActor.type) =~ 'user', 'Regular',
            tostring(DelineaActor.type) in~ ('service', 'serviceuser', 'application'), 'Service Principal',
            'Other'),
        ActorSessionId = tostring(DelineaEvent.sessionId),
        // SecretId is a promoted string column while the target fields are dynamic, so
        // each is converted before coalesce - a mixed argument list is rejected. coalesce
        // skips empty strings, so the name / displayName / containerName / SecretId order holds.
        Object = coalesce(tostring(DelineaTarget.name), tostring(DelineaTarget.displayName), tostring(DelineaTarget.containerName), SecretId),
        ObjectId = tostring(DelineaTarget.id),
        SrcIpAddr = iff(DelineaSrcIpAddr in ('', '0.0.0.0'), '', DelineaSrcIpAddr),
        SrcHostname = tostring(DelineaSourceHost.machineName),
        DstIpAddr = iff(DelineaDstIpAddr in ('', '0.0.0.0'), '', DelineaDstIpAddr),
        DstHostname = tostring(DelineaTargetHost.machineName),
        OldValue = tostring(DelineaEvent.fieldChanges[0].oldValue),
        NewValue = tostring(DelineaEvent.fieldChanges[0].newValue),
        ValueType = 'Other',
        // The Delinea event level is an audit category - SecurityAudit,
        // PrivilegedActivity or SystemActivity - rather than an ASIM severity,
        // so it is carried in AdditionalFields and severity is derived from
        // the event result.
        AdditionalFields = bag_pack(
            'DelineaEventTypeId', DelineaEventType.id,
            'DelineaEventInternalName', DelineaEventType.internalName,
            'DelineaLevel', DelineaEvent.level,
            'DelineaService', DelineaEvent.service.type,
            'DelineaServiceVersion', DelineaEvent.service.version,
            'DelineaTargetType', DelineaTargetTypeOriginal,
            'DelineaTargetContainer', DelineaTarget.containerName,
            'DelineaTargetPlatformId', DelineaTarget.platformId,
            'DelineaActorPlatformId', DelineaActor.platformId,
            'DelineaDelegatedUserName', DelineaActor.delegatedUserName,
            'DelineaTenantId', DelineaEvent.tenantId,
            'DelineaIsSystem', DelineaEvent.isSystem,
            'DelineaVerb', DelineaVerb,
            'DelineaProcessedTime', DelineaEvent.processedTime,
            'DelineaTags', DelineaEvent.tags,
            'DelineaAnalyticData', DelineaEvent.analyticData,
            'DelineaSourceNetwork', DelineaSourceHost.network,
            'DelineaTargetNetwork', DelineaTargetHost.network,
            'AdditionalAttributes', DelineaAttributes,
            'FieldChanges', DelineaEvent.fieldChanges)
    | extend
        EventSeverity = iff(EventResult == 'Failure', 'Low', 'Informational'),
        EventResultDetails = iff(EventResult == 'Failure', DelineaFailReason, ''),
        ActorUsernameType = case(isempty(ActorUsername), '', ActorUsername contains '@', 'UPN', 'Simple'),
        Dvc = strcat(EventVendor, '/', EventProduct)
    // aliases
    | extend
        User = ActorUsername,
        Value = NewValue,
        IpAddr = SrcIpAddr,
        Src = SrcIpAddr
    | project-away
        DelineaEvent,
        DelineaEventType,          // used by EventType, Operation and AdditionalFields
        DelineaActor,              // used by the Actor fields
        DelineaTarget,             // used by Object and ObjectId
        DelineaSourceHost,         // used by the Src fields
        DelineaTargetHost,         // used by the Dst fields
        DelineaAttributes,         // used by EventResult and AdditionalFields
        DelineaEventName,          // used by EventOriginalType and Operation
        DelineaEventNameKey,       // used by EventType and EventResult
        DelineaVerb,               // used by AdditionalFields
        DelineaVerbKey,            // used by EventType
        DelineaTargetType,         // used by ObjectType
        DelineaTargetTypeOriginal, // used by AdditionalFields
        DelineaFailReason,         // used by EventResult and EventResultDetails
        DelineaMfaResult,          // used by EventResult
        DelineaFactorPassword,     // used by EventResult
        DelineaSrcIpAddr,          // used by SrcIpAddr
        DelineaDstIpAddr,          // used by DstIpAddr
        NormalizedEventType,
        NormalizedObjectType,
        RawData,                   // fully expanded above
        Service,                   // serialized service object, expanded from RawData
        Level,                     // used by AdditionalFields, read from RawData
        SecretId,                  // used by Object
        TenantId
};
parser(disabled=disabled)

            DelineaEventNameKey contains 'view' or DelineaEventNameKey contains 'read' or DelineaEventNameKey contains 'retriev' or DelineaEventNameKey contains 'export' or DelineaEventNameKey contains 'download' or DelineaEventNameKey contains 'checkedout' or DelineaEventNameKey contains 'checkout', 'Read',
            DelineaEventNameKey contains 'execut' or DelineaEventNameKey contains 'launch' or DelineaEventNameKey contains 'invoke' or DelineaEventNameKey contains 'run', 'Execute',
            DelineaEventNameKey contains 'install', 'Install',
            DelineaEventNameKey contains 'clear' or DelineaEventNameKey contains 'purge', 'Clear',
            'Other'),
        ObjectType = iff(isempty(NormalizedObjectType), 'Other', NormalizedObjectType),
        EventCount = int(1),
        EventVendor = 'Delinea',
        EventProduct = 'Delinea Platform',
        EventSchema = 'AuditEvent',
        EventSchemaVersion = '0.1.2',
        // eventDateTime is when the platform recorded the event, ahead of the
        // processedTime at which it became available to the connector.
        EventStartTime = coalesce(todatetime(DelineaEvent.eventDateTime), TimeGenerated),
        EventEndTime = coalesce(todatetime(DelineaEvent.eventDateTime), TimeGenerated),
        EventUid = _ItemId,
        EventOriginalUid = tostring(DelineaEvent.eventMessageId),
        EventOriginalType = DelineaEventName,
        EventMessage = tostring(coalesce(DelineaEvent.displayMessage, DelineaEvent.notes)),
        Operation = DelineaEventName,
        EventResult = case(
            DelineaMfaResult =~ 'Failed' or DelineaFactorPassword =~ 'Failed' or isnotempty(DelineaFailReason), 'Failure',
            DelineaVerbKey in ('failed', 'denied', 'rejected', 'blocked'), 'Failure',
            DelineaEventNameKey contains 'fail' or DelineaEventNameKey contains 'denied' or DelineaEventNameKey contains 'reject' or DelineaEventNameKey contains 'blocked' or DelineaEventNameKey contains 'unauthorized', 'Failure',
            'Success'),
        ActorUsername = tostring(coalesce(DelineaActor.email, DelineaActor.name, DelineaActor.displayName)),
        ActorUserId = tostring(DelineaActor.id),
        ActorUserIdType = 'Other',
        ActorOriginalUserType = tostring(DelineaActor.type),
        ActorUserType = case(
            tostring(DelineaActor.type) =~ 'system' or tostring(DelineaEvent.isSystem) =~ 'true', 'System',
            tostring(DelineaActor.type) =~ 'user', 'Regular',
            tostring(DelineaActor.type) in~ ('service', 'serviceuser', 'application'), 'Service Principal',
            'Other'),
        ActorSessionId = tostring(DelineaEvent.sessionId),
        // SecretId is a promoted string column while the target fields are dynamic, so
        // each is converted before coalesce - a mixed argument list is rejected. coalesce
        // skips empty strings, so the name / displayName / containerName / SecretId order holds.
        Object = coalesce(tostring(DelineaTarget.name), tostring(DelineaTarget.displayName), tostring(DelineaTarget.containerName), SecretId),
        ObjectId = tostring(DelineaTarget.id),
        SrcIpAddr = iff(DelineaSrcIpAddr in ('', '0.0.0.0'), '', DelineaSrcIpAddr),
        SrcHostname = tostring(DelineaSourceHost.machineName),
        DstIpAddr = iff(DelineaDstIpAddr in ('', '0.0.0.0'), '', DelineaDstIpAddr),
        DstHostname = tostring(DelineaTargetHost.machineName),
        OldValue = tostring(DelineaEvent.fieldChanges[0].oldValue),
        NewValue = tostring(DelineaEvent.fieldChanges[0].newValue),
        ValueType = 'Other',
        // The Delinea event level is an audit category - SecurityAudit,
        // PrivilegedActivity or SystemActivity - rather than an ASIM severity,
        // so it is carried in AdditionalFields and severity is derived from
        // the event result.
        AdditionalFields = bag_pack(
            'DelineaEventTypeId', DelineaEventType.id,
            'DelineaEventInternalName', DelineaEventType.internalName,
            'DelineaLevel', DelineaEvent.level,
            'DelineaService', DelineaEvent.service.type,
            'DelineaServiceVersion', DelineaEvent.service.version,
            'DelineaTargetType', DelineaTargetTypeOriginal,
            'DelineaTargetContainer', DelineaTarget.containerName,
            'DelineaTargetPlatformId', DelineaTarget.platformId,
            'DelineaActorPlatformId', DelineaActor.platformId,
            'DelineaDelegatedUserName', DelineaActor.delegatedUserName,
            'DelineaTenantId', DelineaEvent.tenantId,
            'DelineaIsSystem', DelineaEvent.isSystem,
            'DelineaVerb', DelineaVerb,
            'DelineaProcessedTime', DelineaEvent.processedTime,
            'DelineaTags', DelineaEvent.tags,
            'DelineaAnalyticData', DelineaEvent.analyticData,
            'DelineaSourceNetwork', DelineaSourceHost.network,
            'DelineaTargetNetwork', DelineaTargetHost.network,
            'AdditionalAttributes', DelineaAttributes,
            'FieldChanges', DelineaEvent.fieldChanges)
    | extend
        EventSeverity = iff(EventResult == 'Failure', 'Low', 'Informational'),
        EventResultDetails = iff(EventResult == 'Failure', DelineaFailReason, ''),
        ActorUsernameType = case(isempty(ActorUsername), '', ActorUsername contains '@', 'UPN', 'Simple'),
        Dvc = strcat(EventVendor, '/', EventProduct)
    // Filters that require normalized values are applied once they exist.
    | where (array_length(eventtype_in) == 0 or EventType has_any (eventtype_in))
        and ('*' in (eventresult) or EventResult in (eventresult))
        and (array_length(actorusername_has_any) == 0 or ActorUsername has_any (actorusername_has_any))
        and (array_length(operation_has_any) == 0 or Operation has_any (operation_has_any))
        and (array_length(object_has_any) == 0 or Object has_any (object_has_any))
        and (array_length(newvalue_has_any) == 0 or NewValue has_any (newvalue_has_any))
        and (array_length(srcipaddr_has_any_prefix) == 0 or has_any_ipv4_prefix(SrcIpAddr, srcipaddr_has_any_prefix))
    // aliases
    | extend
        User = ActorUsername,
        Value = NewValue,
        IpAddr = SrcIpAddr,
        Src = SrcIpAddr
    | project-away
        DelineaEvent,
        DelineaEventType,          // used by EventType, Operation and AdditionalFields
        DelineaActor,              // used by the Actor fields
        DelineaTarget,             // used by Object and ObjectId
        DelineaSourceHost,         // used by the Src fields
        DelineaTargetHost,         // used by the Dst fields
        DelineaAttributes,         // used by EventResult and AdditionalFields
        DelineaEventName,          // used by EventOriginalType and Operation
        DelineaEventNameKey,       // used by EventType and EventResult
        DelineaVerb,               // used by AdditionalFields
        DelineaVerbKey,            // used by EventType
        DelineaTargetType,         // used by ObjectType
        DelineaTargetTypeOriginal, // used by AdditionalFields
        DelineaFailReason,         // used by EventResult and EventResultDetails
        DelineaMfaResult,          // used by EventResult
        DelineaFactorPassword,     // used by EventResult
        DelineaSrcIpAddr,          // used by SrcIpAddr
        DelineaDstIpAddr,          // used by DstIpAddr
        NormalizedEventType,
        NormalizedObjectType,
        RawData,                   // fully expanded above
        Service,                   // serialized service object, expanded from RawData
        Level,                     // used by AdditionalFields, read from RawData
        SecretId,                  // used by Object
        TenantId
};

DelineaMassSecretAccess_AnalyticalRules Analytics Rule with template version 3.0.0

Detects a single user accessing or exporting an unusually large number of distinct secrets in
Delinea Secret Server within a short window. In addition to secret views, this rule also matches
export / download / retrieve operations, which are a stronger signal of vault scraping prior to
exfiltration ("secret hoarding"). Tune 'threshold' to your environment's normal access patterns.

Detects when a user's secret-access volume for the current day significantly exceeds their own
recent baseline (per-user daily average plus a standard-deviation factor over the prior ~14 days).
A sudden spike relative to a principal's normal behaviour can indicate a compromised privileged
account or insider misuse. Tune 'factor' and 'minDaily' to balance noise against coverage.
properties.displayName: Delinea - Privileged account access anomaly (secret-access volume vs baseline)
properties.query:
let factor = 3.0;
let minDaily = 10;
let minBaselineDays = 3;
let secretViews = DelineaAuditEvents_CL
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(14d)
    | where Level == "PrivilegedActivity"
    | extend d = parse_json(RawData)
    | where tostring(d.eventType.name) == "Delinea.Vault.Secret.Viewed"
    | extend Actor = tostring(d.actor.name), SrcIP = tostring(d.source.host.network.ipAddress)
    | where isnotempty(Actor);
let baseline = secretViews
    | where TimeGenerated < ago(1d)
    | summarize Accesses = count() by Actor, Day = bin(TimeGenerated, 1d)
    | summarize BaselineAvg = avg(Accesses), BaselineStdev = stdev(Accesses), BaselineMax = max(Accesses), DaysObserved = count() by Actor;
secretViews
| where TimeGenerated >= ago(1d)
| summarize TodayAccesses = count(), DistinctSecrets = dcount(SecretId), Secrets = make_set(SecretId, 50),
            SourceIPs = make_set(SrcIP, 20), StartTime = min(TimeGenerated), EndTime = max(TimeGenerated) by Actor
| join kind=inner baseline on Actor
| where DaysObserved >= minBaselineDays
| extend AnomalyThreshold = round(BaselineAvg + factor * BaselineStdev, 1)
| where TodayAccesses > AnomalyThreshold and TodayAccesses >= minDaily
| extend DeviationFactor = round(todouble(TodayAccesses) / (BaselineAvg + 1), 1)
| extend SrcIP = tostring(SourceIPs[0])
| project Actor, TodayAccesses, DistinctSecrets, BaselineAvg = round(BaselineAvg, 1), BaselineStdev = round(BaselineStdev, 1),
          BaselineMax, AnomalyThreshold, DeviationFactor, DaysObserved, Secrets, SrcIP, StartTime, EndTime
| sort by DeviationFactor desc

properties.displayName: Delinea - Privileged account access anomaly (secret-access volume vs baseline)

properties.description: DelineaFailedAuthSpike_AnalyticalRules Analytics Rule with template version 3.0.0

Detects when a single account accumulates an unusually high number of failed authentication
events within a short window. Only authentication events - MFA, login and sign-in - are
considered; the service-wide view of every failure lives in the 'Delinea - Failed operations'
hunting query. A failure is a failed MFA result, a failed password factor, or any login fail
reason. A burst of failures for one account can indicate brute-force or credential-stuffing
activity. Tune 'threshold' to your environment.

Detects when a user accesses a high-value secret for the first time, with no access to that
same secret by that user in the prior 14 days. First-time access to a sensitive secret can
indicate lateral movement or credential targeting.
Delinea reports no in-band sensitivity flag, so a secret is treated as high-value when its
name or its folder matches 'sensitivePattern' (common privileged naming conventions), or
when it appears in 'customSecretNames' / 'customFolders'. Both knobs are meant to be edited
at deployment time - the pattern for substring matching, the lists for exact tenant-specific
names. The folder is read from the notes document, since the platform leaves the top-level
target.containerName empty on secret events.
properties.displayName: Delinea - Sensitive secret accessed by new user (first access in 14 days)
Delinea - Sensitive secret accessed by new user (first access in 14 days)

properties.description:
Detects role assignments, permission or right grants, admin grants and elevation events that
the acting user has not performed against the same target in the prior 14 days. Only grant-type actions (added /
assigned / granted / elevated / approved / created / updated) against role, permission,
privilege, admin or entitlement objects are considered; removals and read-only events are
excluded, and plain group-membership or ownership events are not matched because they make up
most routine directory activity. One alert is produced per actor per run - review the
FieldChanges column for the before/after of each change.
Tune 'escalationObjects' and 'grantVerbs' to your tenant's event taxonomy, and use
'excludedEventNames', 'excludedServiceTypes' and 'excludedActors' to silence known-benign
events, services (for example directory synchronization) and service accounts.
properties.displayName: Delinea - Privilege escalation detected (role / permission changes)
Delinea - Privilege escalation detected (role / permission changes)

properties.description:
Detects state-changing modifications (add / update / delete / enable / disable) to critical
Delinea platform settings - authentication profiles and policies, SSO or identity-provider
(SAML / OIDC / OAuth / federation) configuration, IP range / restriction rules and webhooks -
that the acting user has not performed in the prior 14 days. Configuration tampering is
frequently a precursor to defense evasion or persistence; routine changes an administrator
makes regularly are baselined out, while a first-ever change still alerts.
Matching uses the event name only, not the free-text display message, and produces one alert
per actor per run. Tune 'configPattern' to your tenant's event taxonomy, and use
'excludedEventNames', 'excludedServiceTypes' and 'excludedActors' to silence known-benign
events, services (for example directory synchronization) and service accounts.

properties.displayName: Delinea - Authentication failures ranked by account
properties.query:
let lookback = 24h;
// Authentication events only. Matched against eventType.name, falling back to
// internalName, the same way ASimAuditEventDelineaPlatform resolves the event name.
let authEventPattern = @"(?i)mfa|multifactor|\blogin\b|\blogon\b|signin|authentication";
DelineaAuditEvents_CL
| where TimeGenerated > ago(lookback)
| extend d = parse_json(RawData)
| extend Attr = d.additionalAttributes
| extend EventName = tostring(coalesce(d.eventType.name, d.eventType.internalName))
| where EventName matches regex authEventPattern
// The attributes bag carries either scalars or single element arrays depending on
// the reporting service, so both shapes are read - see ASimAuditEventDelineaPlatform.
| extend Actor = tostring(coalesce(d.actor.email, d.actor.name, d.actor.displayName)),
         RawSrcIP = tostring(d.source.host.network.ipAddress),
         MfaResult = tostring(coalesce(Attr.MfaResult[0], Attr.MfaResult)),
         FactorPassword = tostring(coalesce(Attr.FactorPassword[0], Attr.FactorPassword)),
         FailReason = tostring(coalesce(Attr.FailReason[0], Attr.FailReason))
| where MfaResult =~ "Failed" or FactorPassword =~ "Failed" or isnotempty(FailReason)
| where isnotempty(Actor)
// '0.0.0.0' is the placeholder reported for events that have no network origin.
| extend SrcIP = iff(RawSrcIP in ("", "0.0.0.0"), "", RawSrcIP)
| summarize Failures = count(), DistinctSourceIPs = dcountif(SrcIP, isnotempty(SrcIP)),
            SourceIPs = make_set_if(SrcIP, isnotempty(SrcIP), 20),
            FailReasons = make_set_if(FailReason, isnotempty(FailReason), 10),
            SrcIP = take_anyif(SrcIP, isnotempty(SrcIP)),
            StartTime = min(TimeGenerated), EndTime = max(TimeGenerated) by Actor
| extend WindowMinutes = round(todouble(datetime_diff('second', EndTime, StartTime)) / 60, 1)
| project Actor, Failures, DistinctSourceIPs, SourceIPs, FailReasons, SrcIP, WindowMinutes, StartTime, EndTime
| sort by Failures desc

tags.name: description
tags.value:
Surfaces every account with failed authentication activity over the lookback window, ranked by
failure count and distinct source IPs - with no alerting threshold applied. The 'Failed
authentication spike' analytic rule only fires above a tuned threshold (e.g. 10 in 15m); this
hunting query deliberately shows everything below that line so an analyst can spot low-and-slow
brute-force or credential-stuffing that stays under the radar. Scoped to authentication events
to match that rule; for failures across every service use 'Delinea - Failed operations'. Pivot
on accounts with many failures from several IPs, or a single IP hitting many accounts (password
spraying).

properties.displayName: Delinea - Secret access fan-out by user
properties.query:
let lookback = 24h;
let secretEventPattern = @"(?i)\.Secret\.(Viewed|Exported|Downloaded|Retrieved|Copied)";
DelineaAuditEvents_CL
| where TimeGenerated > ago(lookback)
| extend d = parse_json(RawData)
| extend EventName = tostring(d.eventType.name), SrcIP = tostring(d.source.host.network.ipAddress)
| where EventName matches regex secretEventPattern
| extend IsExport = EventName has_any ("Exported", "Downloaded", "Retrieved", "Copied")
| summarize DistinctSecrets = dcount(SecretId), TotalOperations = count(), Exports = countif(IsExport),
            Secrets = make_set(SecretId, 50), SourceIPs = make_set(SrcIP, 20), SrcIP = take_any(SrcIP),
            StartTime = min(TimeGenerated), EndTime = max(TimeGenerated) by User
| extend ExportRatio = round(todouble(Exports) / TotalOperations, 2)
| project User, DistinctSecrets, TotalOperations, Exports, ExportRatio, Secrets, SourceIPs, SrcIP, StartTime, EndTime
| sort by DistinctSecrets desc

tags.name: description
tags.value:
Ranks users by the number of distinct secrets they accessed or exported over the lookback window,
with no alerting threshold applied. The 'Bulk secret export / access' analytic rule only fires
above a tuned distinct-secret threshold; this hunting query shows the full distribution so an
analyst can establish what normal access fan-out looks like per principal and spot users trending
upward before they cross the alert line. The Exports column highlights anyone whose activity is
weighted toward export / download rather than ordinary views.

| extend d = parse_json(RawData)

tags.name: description
tags.value:
Summarizes every Delinea Platform audit event over the lookback window grouped by the acting user,
with no alerting threshold applied. Gives an analyst a single per-principal activity baseline -
total events, which services and event types each user touched, how many distinct source IPs they
came from, and their first/last activity in range. Pivot on users with an unusually broad event-type
or source-IP footprint, or use it as the starting point for a deeper per-user investigation.

properties.description: DelineaEventsBySeverity_HuntingQueries Hunting Query with template version 3.0.0

let lookback = 24h;
DelineaAuditEvents_CL
| where TimeGenerated > ago(lookback)
| extend Level = iif(isempty(Level), "Unknown", Level)
| summarize Events = count(),
            DistinctUsers = dcount(User), Users = make_set(User, 30),
            DistinctEventTypes = dcount(EventType), TopEventTypes = make_set(EventType, 25),

            FirstSeen = min(TimeGenerated), LastSeen = max(TimeGenerated)

tags.name: description
tags.value:
Breaks down the Delinea Platform audit stream by event severity / level (e.g. PrivilegedActivity,
Info, Warning, Error) over the lookback window, with no alerting threshold applied. Shows the event
count, distinct users, and the top event types contributing to each level so an analyst can gauge the
overall mix of activity and zero in on the higher-severity tiers. Use it to spot an unusual spike of
privileged or error-level events relative to normal volume.

properties.description: DelineaFailedOperations_HuntingQueries Hunting Query with template version 3.0.0

properties.query:
let lookback = 24h;
DelineaAuditEvents_CL
| where TimeGenerated > ago(lookback)
| extend d = parse_json(RawData)
| extend Attr = d.additionalAttributes
| extend EventName = tostring(coalesce(d.eventType.name, d.eventType.internalName)),
         Msg = tostring(d.displayMessage),
         RawSrcIP = tostring(d.source.host.network.ipAddress)
// The attributes bag carries either scalars or single element arrays depending on
// the reporting service, so both shapes are read - see ASimAuditEventDelineaPlatform.
| extend MfaResult = tostring(coalesce(Attr.MfaResult[0], Attr.MfaResult)),
         FactorPassword = tostring(coalesce(Attr.FactorPassword[0], Attr.FactorPassword)),
         FailReason = tostring(coalesce(Attr.FailReason[0], Attr.FailReason))
| where MfaResult =~ "Failed" or FactorPassword =~ "Failed" or isnotempty(FailReason)
    or EventName has_any ("Failed", "Failure", "Error", "Denied", "Unauthorized", "Rejected")
    or Msg has_any ("failed", "failure", "denied", "unauthorized", "rejected", "error")
// '0.0.0.0' is the placeholder reported for events that have no network origin.
| extend SrcIP = iff(RawSrcIP in ("", "0.0.0.0"), "", RawSrcIP)
| project TimeGenerated, User, Service, EventName, Level, Msg, FailReason, SrcIP
| sort by TimeGenerated desc

tags.name: description
tags.value:
Surfaces every failed, denied, or errored operation across all Delinea Platform services over the
lookback window, with no alerting threshold applied. Failures are identified from failed MFA / password
factors, any login fail reason, or an event name / message containing failed / error / denied /
unauthorized. Unlike the 'Failed authentication spike' rule (auth only, above a tuned threshold) this
hunting query is service-wide and shows everything, so an analyst can spot scattered authorization
failures, repeated errors against a resource, or low-and-slow access attempts.

properties.description: DelineaConfigChanges_HuntingQueries Hunting Query with template version 3.0.0

properties.query:
let lookback = 7d;
let configPattern = @"(?i)policy|profile|authentication|\bsso\b|saml|oidc|oauth|federation|identityprovider|\bidp\b|iprange|iprestriction|webhook|integration|connector|setting|configuration|\brole\b|permission";
DelineaAuditEvents_CL
| where TimeGenerated > ago(lookback)
| extend d = parse_json(RawData)
| extend EventName = tostring(d.eventType.name), Msg = tostring(d.displayMessage),
         Target = tostring(d.target.displayName), SrcIP = tostring(d.source.host.network.ipAddress),
         FieldChanges = tostring(d.fieldChanges)
| where (EventName matches regex configPattern or Msg matches regex configPattern)
    and EventName !has "Viewed" and Msg !has "viewed"
| project TimeGenerated, User, Service, EventName, Target, Msg, FieldChanges, SrcIP
| sort by TimeGenerated desc

tags.name: description
tags.value:
Threshold-free audit trail of state-changing modifications to Delinea platform configuration over the
lookback window - authentication profiles, security / access policies, SSO or identity-provider
(SAML / OIDC / federation) settings, IP range / restriction rules, integration / webhook / connector
settings, and role / permission changes. Read-only "viewed" events are excluded so only add / update /
delete / enable / disable actions remain. The matching analytic rule only fires on its own schedule;
this query lets an analyst review the full change history and inspect the FieldChanges before/after.
Tune 'configPattern' to your tenant's event taxonomy.

properties.query:
let lookback = 24h;
let secretEventPattern = @"(?i)\.Secret\.";
DelineaAuditEvents_CL
| where TimeGenerated > ago(lookback)
| extend d = parse_json(RawData)
| extend EventName = tostring(d.eventType.name), Msg = tostring(d.displayMessage),
         SrcIP = tostring(d.source.host.network.ipAddress)
| where EventName matches regex secretEventPattern
| extend Action = extract(@"\.Secret\.(\w+)", 1, EventName)
| project TimeGenerated, User, SecretId, Action, EventName, Level, Msg, SrcIP

tags.name: description
tags.value:
Chronological, per-event audit trail of every Delinea Secret Server secret operation over the lookback
window - views, exports, downloads, retrievals, copies, edits and deletes - with no alerting threshold
applied. Each row records who performed the action, which secret, the derived action verb, the source
IP, and the original message. Unlike the 'Secret access fan-out' query (aggregated per user) this is the
raw event-by-event trail, ideal for reconstructing exactly what happened to a given secret or what a
user did during an incident window.

properties.description: DelineaActivityBySourceIP_HuntingQueries Hunting Query with template version 3.0.0

properties.query:
let lookback = 24h;
DelineaAuditEvents_CL
| where TimeGenerated > ago(lookback)
| extend d = parse_json(RawData)
| extend SrcIP = tostring(d.source.host.network.ipAddress)
| where isnotempty(SrcIP)
| summarize Events = count(),
            DistinctUsers = dcount(User), Users = make_set(User, 30),
            DistinctServices = dcount(Service), Services = make_set(Service, 20),
            DistinctEventTypes = dcount(EventType),

tags.name: description
tags.value:
Summarizes Delinea Platform activity grouped by source IP address over the lookback window, with no
alerting threshold applied. For each IP it reports the event count, how many distinct users and services
it touched, the event-type footprint, and first/last seen. A single IP associated with many distinct
accounts can indicate password spraying, a shared NAT / VPN egress, or a compromised host proxying
activity; pivot on IPs with an unexpectedly high distinct-user count or originating from unfamiliar
networks.

properties.query:
let lookback = 7d;
let bizStartHourUtc = 7;
let bizEndHourUtc = 19;
DelineaAuditEvents_CL
| where TimeGenerated > ago(lookback)
| where Level == "PrivilegedActivity"
| extend d = parse_json(RawData)
| extend EventName = tostring(d.eventType.name), Msg = tostring(d.displayMessage),
         SrcIP = tostring(d.source.host.network.ipAddress)
| extend HourUtc = datetime_part("hour", TimeGenerated), Dow = dayofweek(TimeGenerated)
| where HourUtc < bizStartHourUtc or HourUtc >= bizEndHourUtc or Dow == 0d or Dow == 6d
| project TimeGenerated, HourUtc, User, Service, EventName, SecretId, Msg, SrcIP
| sort by TimeGenerated desc

tags.name: description
tags.value:
Surfaces privileged-activity events (Level == "PrivilegedActivity") that occur outside normal business
hours - before 'bizStartHourUtc', after 'bizEndHourUtc', or on a weekend - over the lookback window,
with no alerting threshold applied. Privileged operations such as secret access or configuration changes
performed at unusual times can indicate a compromised account, an attacker operating in a different time
zone, or insider activity outside oversight. Tune the business-hours window (UTC) to your operating
region.

properties.description: DelineaRareEventTypes_HuntingQueries Hunting Query with template version 3.0.0

properties.query:
let baseline = 14d;
let recent = 1d;
let seenBefore = DelineaAuditEvents_CL
    | where TimeGenerated between (ago(baseline) .. ago(recent))
    | distinct EventType;
DelineaAuditEvents_CL
| where TimeGenerated > ago(recent)
| where isnotempty(EventType)
| join kind=leftanti (seenBefore) on EventType
| extend d = parse_json(RawData)
| extend SrcIP = tostring(d.source.host.network.ipAddress)
| summarize Events = count(),
            DistinctUsers = dcount(User), Users = make_set(User, 20), Actor = take_any(User),
            SrcIP = take_any(SrcIP),
            FirstSeen = min(TimeGenerated), LastSeen = max(TimeGenerated)
        by EventType, Service
| sort by FirstSeen desc

Identifies Delinea Platform event types that appear in the recent window but were never seen during the
preceding baseline period, using a leftanti join against the baseline set - with no alerting threshold
applied. A brand-new event type can signal a newly enabled feature, a configuration change, or an
attacker exercising functionality the environment does not normally use. Pivot on the users and source
IPs associated with each first-seen event type to decide whether it is benign. Tune 'baseline' and
'recent' to your environment.
